forecastTiming: A completed-Week N row uses only NFL usage through Week N and the Sleeper Week N roster snapshot.

featureDefinitions.lineupSnapShare: Maximum one-week offensive snap-share sum under the league's QB/2RB/2WR/TE/FLEX skill slots.
featureDefinitions.lineupOpportunities: Maximum one-week targets plus carries under the same slots.
featureDefinitions.lineupTargetShare: Maximum nflverse target-share sum under the same slots.
featureDefinitions.lineupRedZoneOpportunities: Maximum carries plus targets from the opponent 20 or closer under the same slots.
featureDefinitions.lineupDepthScore: Maximum inverse depth-team rank under the same slots (1, 0.5, 0.333, ...).
featureDefinitions.trailing*: Mean player usage across the last three available weeks, then optimized under the same slots.
featureDefinitions.targetPerOffensiveSnap: Roster targets divided by roster offensive snaps; a demand proxy, not routes run.

limitations: Direct routes run are not present in nflverse's public all-season player/snap/depth files; target-per-snap is explicitly a proxy.
The nflverse depth-chart source changed in 2025 and no longer contains historical week values; 2025 depth scores are therefore left at zero rather than backfilled from a later snapshot.
Usage is backward-looking and cannot encode injuries or role changes first known after the completed-week cutoff.
PFR snap/depth identifiers are joined to Sleeper through nflverse weekly rosters; unmapped players contribute zero rather than guessed values.
Team defenses and kickers are excluded because the requested role features are offensive player usage features.
The output is research-only and is not imported by the production simulator.
